events.name: IMPERIAL PATROL
events.description: Stormtrooper patrol sweeping the area. All operatives take cover and avoid open ground.

events.name: INCOMING SANDSTORM
events.description: Sand levels rising. Visibility dropping. Move quickly between buildings.

events.name: CANTINA LOCKDOWN
events.description: Imperial security has locked down the cantina. Avoid the area until further notice.

events.name: BOUNTY POSTED
events.description: High-value target identified. Check the wanted board.

events.name: ALL CLEAR
events.description: Patrol has moved on. Resume normal operations.

events.name: EXTRACTION INBOUND
events.description: Lambda shuttle inbound for pickup. All operatives complete current objectives and report in.

comms.subject: PATROL WARNING
comms.body: Imperial patrol detected. Avoid the speeder repair area for the next 5 minutes.

comms.subject: PRIORITY ALERT
comms.body: A bounty hunter has been spotted near the cantina. Check the wanted board for details.

comms.subject: EXTRACTION DETAILS
comms.body: Once R5 has the intel, regroup at the cafe for pickup. Lambda shuttle ETA 10 minutes.

comms.subject: FIELD COMMENDATION
comms.body: Outstanding work, operative. Mission objectives complete. Your service is logged.

bounties.description: Rodian bounty hunter casing the Twin Suns Cantina. Armed, opportunistic, working freelance for the Empire.
clues: Last seen at the cantina bar. Green skin, big black eyes, holstered DT-12 blaster.
Asked the bartender about Rebel sympathizers. Suspects something.
Heading toward the speeder repair area — intercept before he reaches the terminal.
